newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver prices ease on low buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver prices ease on low buying.

text.p: Indian gold and silver prices eased in early trade on Thursday, dealers said.
Physical buying and volumes were low. On Wednesday gold was down by 30 rupees per 10 grammes and silver was down by 70 rupees per kg.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) slid by 100 rupees to 57,200 rupees. They were down by 300 rupees on Wednesday.

"Fresh arrivals of imported metals were low today and traders are expecting prices to bounce back later in the day looking at the rising premiums of special licences to import precious metals in India," said Mahavir Shah, a leading jeweller.
